sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. S. Panda, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Special Case No.130 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (PCOSO), Balasore, arising out of Basta P.S. Case No.138 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 366/376(3)/506/323/34 IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to implead the Informant as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title along with requisites for issuance of notice by Registered Post to the newly added Opposite Party, shall be filed by 14.07.2025.
4. List this matter along with ABLAPL Nos. 6704 of 2025 & 6721 of 2025 on 08.08.2025.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
In the event requisites are not filed, as directed, the interim order shall stand vacated.
6. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.

(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Sk. Salim @ Sk vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183018436/
